verdict.rationale: Each sync connects one model to one destination and defines how fields map into it, with field mapping configurable in the app or via API. That implies per-destination control over which attributes are sent, so sensitive fields can be left out by not mapping them or by excluding them in the model SQL. Nothing in the pack documents hashing, masking, or a dedicated PII-governance feature. Missing for 10: documented hashing of identifiers, masking or redaction of sensitive fields, explicit field-level PII filtering or blocking policies per destination, and independent corroboration.
